document.seo_description: Our story, mission and the people behind Treasure Academy, Ageva — a Pre-Nursery to Primary 6 school serving Ageva and Okene, Kogi State.

payload.text: Treasure Academy was founded in 2016 by Shaibu Sidikat Ruth to serve children and families in Ageva, Okene. The school began with a clear purpose: to help children grow in knowledge, character and confidence.
The school offers Pre-Nursery, Nursery 1–2, Primary 1–4 and Primary 6 . Its stated focus is to build strong academic foundations, good character and readiness for each child's next stage.
Families are encouraged to visit the school and ask the office to confirm current facilities, class arrangements and availability.
To help children grow in knowledge, character and confidence through strong academics, clear guidance and good morals.
To nurture confident, capable and well-mannered children who are ready for the next stage of their education.
Official details families can use to identify our school.
Treasure Academy Ageva Limited CAC Registration Number: RC 9634403
Approved Common Entrance Examination Centre Centre No. BS/OKN/141
Use the verified contacts or arrange a visit. The office can confirm current facilities, staffing and class information.

The school office can confirm current leadership, class teachers and the right person for a family question. Staff profiles are not published until the school approves the details and any photograph.
Meet the people, policies and partners who support Treasure Academy.

Treasure Academy, our dear school, Where wisdom shines and hearts are true. In knowledge, character and fear of God, We grow together, strong and true. Our God is able! Our God is able! We rise in learning, we shine as one. Treasure Academy, lead us on — To serve our land and God alone!

document.title: Privacy Policy
document.summary: How Treasure Academy, Ageva handles website preferences, verified contact channels and school records, including children's privacy and parent rights.
document.seo_title: Privacy Policy — Treasure Academy, Ageva
document.seo_description: How Treasure Academy, Ageva handles website preferences, verified contact channels and school records, including children's privacy and parent rights.

payload.text: Treasure Academy, Ageva is a Pre-Nursery, Nursery and Primary school established in 2016 in Ageva, Okene, Kogi State, Nigeria. It is operated by Treasure Academy Ageva Limited , an incorporated company registered in Nigeria ( RC-9634403 ). This policy applies to the public website and to records received and kept by the school office.

The public Request & Verification Centre records the request type, your name, Nigerian phone number, optional email and class, subject, message, source, status and school follow-up notes. After the request is saved, it issues a public reference and a private tracking code. Only a one-way hash of that private code is retained, so the readable code cannot be recovered.

The public website does not accept portal passwords, result entries, full medical files, bank-card details or payment claims. A request reference confirms receipt only; it does not approve admission, verify payment or promise an outcome. Authorised staff may register a phone, generic WhatsApp or office conversation in the same system and issue both tracking values privately.

The website may keep non-sensitive preferences on your device, such as light or dark mode. During the current tab session, it may also keep a selected class and standard enquiry wording so a class-page link can prepare the correct Request Centre fields, plus a short list of broad action categories such as “opened fees” or “search category: admissions”.
It does not store a typed name, phone number, email address, free-text enquiry or raw search words in that browser storage.
A service worker may cache public pages and brand assets for basic offline access. You can clear these copies in your browser settings.
Vercel Speed Insights measures anonymous performance signals: route, network class, browser, device type, operating system, country, Web Vitals and the page element involved.

The measurement is not tied to an individual or IP address. It does not receive form content or raw search words, and it does not load when the browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control. There is no advertising tracker or session recording.

The school office may collect pupil, parent, admission, attendance, result, fee and safeguarding information through its verified office processes. We use it only to operate the school, contact families, teach and assess pupils, protect children and meet legal or regulatory duties.

For parent access, the portal may use the pupil’s typed register name, selected class, the authenticated parent account and a school-issued one-time linking code. It never displays a class list to the parent. Only a SHA-256 hash of a pupil-linking or second-parent invitation code is stored. A successful code creates a recorded parent–pupil relationship; later access uses the parent’s ordinary phone-and-password sign-in.

A pupil may have no more than two active parent or guardian accounts. A second-parent invitation is separate from the original pupil code, bound to the intended Nigerian phone number and consumed after use. New-pupil applications remain separate from existing-pupil linking, payments and final admission decisions.

WhatsApp, email, telephone and Google Maps are separate services with their own privacy practices. WhatsApp remains an optional generic contact channel, not the endpoint for a structured website request. Avoid sending passwords, PINs or full medical records through ordinary chat.

Phone verification processor: when Treasure Academy enables automated WhatsApp authentication delivery, Paragon Hub acts only as the school’s separated technical processor for the registered phone number, short-lived one-time code, expiry and delivery status. That relay is not sent a pupil or parent name, class, result, admission record, payment, password or school-database credential. Treasure Academy Ageva Limited remains the publisher and data controller.
4. How we store and protect school records
The school office limits pupil and family records to the Headmistress and authorised staff who need them for their work.

items: The secure portal is a separate authenticated record system and is activated only after preservation, migration and access checks.
Records are kept only for a necessary school, safeguarding or legal purpose.
Records are disposed of safely when no longer required.

payload.text: We never sell personal information. We share it only with appropriate authority, consent or a safeguarding or legal requirement.
The public website does not publish a child’s password, candidate number, individual marks, date of birth, phone number or medical details.

items: A child’s photograph, name or achievement requires appropriate parent or guardian authority.
A parent or guardian may ask the school to remove an identifiable photograph or profile.

payload.text: As a parent or guardian you can ask us to:

items: See the information we hold about you and your child;
Correct anything that is wrong or out of date;
Delete information we no longer need to keep;

payload.text: To make any of these requests, or if you have a concern about how we handle your data, please contact the school (see below).
We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed. Significant changes will be announced on the school notice board and this page.
Questions about this policy or your child's information can be sent to the school:
Email: Call: WhatsApp: 0906 393 2487 Address: Opposite Morak Pure-Water Factory, Ageva, Okene, Kogi State.

document.title: Safeguarding & Child Protection
document.summary: Safeguarding and child protection at Treasure Academy, Ageva — how we keep every pupil safe and how parents, pupils and staff can raise a concern.
document.seo_title: Safeguarding & Child Protection — Treasure Academy, Ageva
document.seo_description: Safeguarding and child protection at Treasure Academy, Ageva — how we keep every pupil safe and how parents, pupils and staff can raise a concern.

payload.text: Treasure Academy provides a safe, caring and welcoming place for every pupil to learn and grow.
Every member of staff shares responsibility for protecting children from harm, neglect, bullying and abuse. Every adult on the premises must uphold this duty.

items: Pupils are supervised throughout the school day, at play and at events.
Only known parents, guardians or persons named by them may collect a child.
Visitors report to the office and are not left alone with pupils.
A first-aid point is kept on site; each pupil's blood group and health notes are held for emergencies.
Teachers and support staff are recruited with references and interviews.
Staff are briefed on child care and protection and follow a code of conduct.
Risky adult behaviour is handled firmly and reported to the appropriate authority when required.

payload.text: We do not tolerate bullying of any kind. Pupils are taught to treat one another with respect, and any incident is taken seriously, investigated and addressed with the children and families involved. Discipline is firm but never degrading or harmful.
Where pupils use computers for Common Entrance practice and learning, activity is supervised and limited to approved material. We teach children simple, age-appropriate rules for staying safe online.

Our Designated Safeguarding Lead is the Headmistress, Mrs. Salihu Nanahawa . If you are a parent, pupil or member of staff and you are worried about the safety or welfare of any child, please tell us straight away. You can:

items: Speak to the Headmistress or a teacher in person at the school;

payload.text: Every concern is listened to, taken seriously and handled sensitively. We will act to protect the child and, where needed, involve parents and the appropriate authorities.
